entities.summary: "The Black Bull of Norroway" is a fairy tale from Scotland. A version titled "The Black Bull of Norroway" in the 1870 edition of Popular Rhymes of Scotland was reprinted in an Anglicised version by Joseph Jacobs in his 1894 book More English Fairy Tales. Classified as Tier E (Oral Tradition) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
